# Tools

<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-START -->
<!-- A short orientation for this page; task guidance belongs under Use. Kept across regeneration. -->
<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-END -->

Every tool runs with the server's own privileges; the [security model](../../security-model.md) says what that reaches.

| Group | Tool | Title | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Papers | [`search_papers`](papers.md#search_papers) | Search Papers | Search Semantic Scholar for papers matching a query. |
| Papers | [`get_paper`](papers.md#get_paper) | Get Paper | Fetch full metadata for a single paper. |
| Papers | [`get_author`](papers.md#get_author) | Get Author | Fetch author profile and publications, or search by name. |
| Citation graph | [`get_citations`](citation-graph.md#get_citations) | Get Citations | Fetch papers that cite the given paper (forward citations). |
| Citation graph | [`get_references`](citation-graph.md#get_references) | Get References | Fetch papers referenced by the given paper (backward references). |
| Citation graph | [`get_citation_graph`](citation-graph.md#get_citation_graph) | Get Citation Graph | Traverse the citation graph from one or more seed papers. |
| Citation graph | [`find_bridge_papers`](citation-graph.md#find_bridge_papers) | Find Bridge Papers | Find the shortest citation path between two papers. |
| Recommendations | [`recommend_papers`](recommendations.md#recommend_papers) | Recommend Papers | Recommend papers based on positive (and optionally negative) examples. |
| Cross source | [`batch_resolve`](cross-source.md#batch_resolve) | Batch Resolve Identifiers | Resolve a list of paper, patent, or book identifiers to full records. |
| Cross source | [`enrich_paper`](cross-source.md#enrich_paper) | Enrich Paper | Fetch OpenAlex metadata to supplement Semantic Scholar data. |
| Full text | [`fetch_paper_pdf`](full-text.md#fetch_paper_pdf) | Fetch Paper PDF | Download the PDF of a paper. |
| Full text | [`convert_pdf_to_markdown`](full-text.md#convert_pdf_to_markdown) | Convert PDF to Markdown | Convert a local PDF to Markdown using docling-serve. |
| Full text | [`fetch_and_convert`](full-text.md#fetch_and_convert) | Fetch and Convert Paper | Resolve a paper, download its PDF, and convert to Markdown. |
| Full text | [`fetch_pdf_by_url`](full-text.md#fetch_pdf_by_url) | Fetch PDF by URL | Download a PDF from a URL and optionally convert to Markdown. |
| Citations | [`generate_citations`](citations.md#generate_citations) | Generate Citations | Generate formatted citations for one or more papers. |
| Patents | [`search_patents`](patents.md#search_patents) | Search Patents | Search for patents in the European Patent Office database. |
| Patents | [`get_patent`](patents.md#get_patent) | Get Patent | Get detailed information about a single patent. |
| Patents | [`get_citing_patents`](patents.md#get_citing_patents) | Get Citing Patents | Find patents that cite a given academic paper. |
| Patents | [`fetch_patent_pdf`](patents.md#fetch_patent_pdf) | Fetch Patent PDF | Download a patent PDF via authenticated EPO OPS and convert to Markdown. |
| Books | [`search_books`](books.md#search_books) | Search Books | Search for books by title, author, or free text. |
| Books | [`get_book`](books.md#get_book) | Get Book | Fetch book metadata by ISBN or Open Library ID. |
| Books | [`get_book_excerpt`](books.md#get_book_excerpt) | Get Book Excerpt | Get a book excerpt and preview info from Google Books. |
| Books | [`recommend_books`](books.md#recommend_books) | Recommend Books | Recommend books for a subject via Open Library. |
| Standards | [`resolve_standard_identifier`](standards.md#resolve_standard_identifier) | Resolve Standard Identifier | Normalise a messy standard citation string to its canonical form. |
| Standards | [`search_standards`](standards.md#search_standards) | Search Standards | Search technical standards by identifier, title, or free text. |
| Standards | [`get_standard`](standards.md#get_standard) | Get Standard | Retrieve a standard by identifier (canonical or fuzzy). |
| Standards | [`get_sync_status`](standards.md#get_sync_status) | Get Sync Status | Report the last standards sync run for each standards body. |
| Jobs | [`get_job_result`](jobs.md#get_job_result) | Get Job Result | Get the status of a background job started by a long-running tool on this server; returns status (working, completed or failed) with the result or error once it finishes. |
| Server info | [`get_server_info`](server_info.md#get_server_info) | Server Info | Report the version information of scholar-mcp; returns `server_name`, `server_version`, `core_version`, the MCP protocol revisions supported and the revision and client of this connection, and, when configured, the upstream service's version. |
